notes.title: Demo Update for September 15, 2025
notes.content:
[p]The Fortified Space demo is reaching a really good spot.  The positive feedback from players continues to roll in, and it is keeping me energized heading into Steam Next Fest.  Don't forget to give this game a wishlist if you haven't already!  This round of updates mostly focuses on making the game more visually appealing.  Some of the improvements include:  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Bloom and glow effects have been added to human and alien starships, allowing engines to smolder and flames to illuminate.  Alien ships now have a bright red outer ring.  Railgun shots burn brightly for the split second they are visible.  Your ship is bathed in light as it comes out of warp.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/27e0f398fea869cf3e3a88edcac09598bea105a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Ship point-defense turrets no longer fire dull streams of yellow shells; they now shoot glowing white shells that kind of look like stars.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/9d888662f8b0ce65c92916f8dd83749959668f05.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]When in orbit around a planet, there are sunlight effects to show the proximity to a star.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/7ccf28a79f2639154436ce88bdcb2f614edb830e.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The Mission Select console aboard your ship now flashes slowly so that new players will know where to go for mission select.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/dd7fbc3fd9e0a7f0fb3849315e63ad2d193fa0a9.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Shadows are now visible whenever the player is on the surface of a planet.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/95dde35f43ab43bc0f28a9ad001ba5232c521b6d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Also, to celebrate one month of updates since the demo was first released, I recorded a new playthrough video and trailer.  These capture most of the improvements I have made to the demo over the past month.  I hope you enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]Trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="mYzRYOFbARE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Full Demo Playthrough:[/p][previewyoutube="DJwFv1bmWQM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i]
[/p]

notes.content: [list][*][p]Added confirmation prompt to Restart Mission button to prevent accidental restarts.[/p][/*][*][p]Your view automatically zooms in when getting out of your chair.[/p][/*][*][p]Your view automatically zooms out when leaving your ship via shuttle.[/p][/*][*][p]The news, which updates after each mission, is now more visually appealing with a blue background.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update for August 27, 2025
notes.content: [p]The demo is starting to reach a great steady-state, so I plan to start slowing the pace of demo updates and to instead renew my focus on full game features.  Thanks to all of you who have played the demo and provided your feedback so far.  Ultimately, I am now hearing that sentence that every game dev yearns for: "this is fun."  The foundation is set, and it is now up to me to pack the full Early Access release with all the goodies I have in mind.  I'll keep posting development updates here, but you'll need to wishlist and buy the full game to enjoy the new features![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/9f8153531d14f2a2732dd6721c31514c9c4a349a.png"][/img][/p][p]With this demo update, I've added naval officer ranks that you earn based on career enemy kill count.  This kill count persists across saves, meaning even if you start a new game, you retain your kill count and rank as a true measure of your experience.  For early ranks, you earn promotions after 200 kills; for later ranks, it may take more than that.  In playtesting, a planet mission will often net you about 250 kills.[/p][p][/p][p]In the full game, I plan to tie your rank to your eligibility for certain upgrades, such as improved weapons, armor, and maybe even ship types, that you would be able to obtain on Earth.  In the meantime, I hope you enjoy this feature as a nice experience tracker.  Personally, I just like seeing my shiny rank insignia in the bottom right corner of my screen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/de570af519ea29164506b7c9a22acb4052f17ce6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Officer Ranks of the Unified Earth Navy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ensign[/p][/*][*][p]Lieutenant, J.G.[/p][/*][*][p]Lieutenant[/p][/*][*][p]Lt. Commander[/p][/*][*][p]Commander[/p][/*][*][p]Captain[/p][/*][*][p]Commodore[/p][/*][*][p]Rear Admiral[/p][/*][*][p]Vice Admiral[/p][/*][*][p]Admiral[/p][/*][*][p]Fleet Admiral[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update for August 18, 2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/6f13a528062629ef30aa43409d9a435247ea564d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to all of you who have tried the demo so far!  In response to player feedback, I'm proud to present the [b]second round of updates for the Fortified Space demo[/b].  This time, the focus was on perfecting the difficulty of the ground combat and adding a few quality-of-life improvements as well.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ground Combat Difficulty[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Body Armor: [/b]Your character will now deploy to planets with body armor that can deflect one hit by an enemy combatant. This means that if you accidentally brush up against an enemy, the armor will take all of the damage.  In its damaged state, the armor can no longer protect you from subsequent hits; however, it has self-repairing technology that can automatically restore its protective ability after about 40 seconds.  Just make sure not to get clobbered while your armor is repairing itself! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Advance warning of enemy attack: [/b]Certain actions, like collecting a certain number of resources, building a certain amount of defenses, or others, will alert the enemy forces to your location and begin the combat phase of your planetary landing.  You no longer have to be caught unprepared when it happens!  The sensor officer from your ship will radio in when enemies start approaching at the beginning of the mission.  You'll have a 60 second warning so that you can start building if you haven't already.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy spawning: [/b]Enemies will now attack later than they did before, giving you more time to gather resources and build a basic base before having to fight.  They will also spawn in lower numbers, with the specifics depending on difficulty setting.  This means no more getting chased right at the beginning![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You will now see the nearest enemy ship's health bar when attacking them.[/p][/*][*][p]Your weapons officer will call out the number of seconds left until your railguns are ready to fire again.[/p][/*][*][p]Instructions were updated to encourage talking to your ship's crew for tips and tricks.  They also add emphasis to the fact that planet facilities are destroyed instantly when an enemy attacks them.[/p][/*][*][p]If you do not have enough materials to build a certain defense structure or facility, clicking on its icon will no longer create a green build cursor.  It's helpful in the heat of battle when you don't have time to look at your inventory![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Extended Fleet Battle[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Guys, the fleet battle mission is really fun.  Railgunning enemy ships while missiles fly at you from every direction and allied frigates shoot them out of the air is one of my own favorite feelings in the game so far.  Because of this, I extended the demo version to allow 60 seconds of this mission, rather than the previous 30 seconds, so that you can get a better taste of that mission type.  This change wasn't due to player feedback, I just really like that part of the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy trying out these improvements to the demo.  Don’t forget to wishlist the full game for many more features and missions![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/15496e2bc83ca5525bae1d5e005ac2dc92eec19f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update for August 12, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]First updates for the demo![/h2][p][/p][p]The Fortified Space demo is now out in the world, and I couldn’t have hoped for a more successful launch!  My deepest thanks to all of you who picked up the demo and gave the game a try so far.  The increase in wishlist numbers for the full game has been mind-boggling as well, and I’m certainly more motivated than ever to continue building and improving on Fortified Space.  I never thought this game would get the amount of positive attention that it has so far.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/109a095dd3191bc8b679f34240a471c7897bf152.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the things I’ve loved the most about this demo launch is hearing all the new ideas that you have, whether it is quality-of-life improvements or thoughts on where the game should go in the future.  Someone even suggested adding in planet colonization and civilization building.  Look, at this point in development, technically anything is possible, although some ideas might take longer to implement than others!  Anyway, I’ve been listening and taking lots of notes.  To that end, I’m happy to announce the following initial updates to the demo, based on player feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]Improving ship handling and flight mechanics[/b]: You know, I wasn’t that surprised to hear that some of you ended up spinning uncontrollably into deep space on your first playthroughs.  Your ship can have a bit of a kick!  To improve how your ship handles, I added a speed limit where previously there was technically none.  Hopefully, it will feel more like you’re piloting a starship and less like you’re flying a runaway horse!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ship shields and incoming missile tracking: [/b]Those missiles really sneak up on you, don’t they?  Don’t worry, I hear you!  To enhance the ship-to-ship combat experience, I’ve added energy shields to your ship that automatically activate in the presence of an enemy vessel.  These shields auto-rotate to face the closest missile, and can absorb two hits before failing.  This way, not only will you be better protected, but you’ll also know which direction incoming missiles are coming from.  Just watch where your shield faces and you’ll know where to aim your defense turret.  I also slightly lowered the speed of the missiles at normal difficulty to make it a more enjoyable fight.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Achievements: [/b]I added several Steam Achievements for you to collect in-game!   See if you can unlock them all.  Hopefully, in the process, you’ll get a fuller demo experience.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Farming Instructions: [/b]I added better prompts to guide you through the hydroponic farming process.  There is also now a pop-up showing growth progress, so you don’t have to keep going back to the controls to check!  Hopefully this makes it easier to do other activities while you wait for your plants to mature.[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m very excited to keep building and improving as more of you continue to play the Fortified Space demo.  I want to make sure the game is the best it can be, and all of you are such an important part of that.  Thanks for being here, and I hope you’re having fun![/p][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Development Update: The Music of the Fortified Space Demo
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="ram0zX3yYe8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Well, I'm a composer now!  As we reach the final weeks before the release of the Fortified Space free demo, one of the last things I'm doing is making songs for the game's original soundtrack.  I played a bit of piano and guitar in my youth, and I do not have much of a budget for this game, so I decided that I would try to make the music on my own.  Making a video game as a solo developer really exposes you to a wide variety of artistic pursuits, I've learned.  Whew, what a lot of work!
[/p][p]A playlist of the songs I composed so far for the demo can be found here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCCmASW0flqn-DVUGVTCBdd3oTbSK_aKR&si=JJUrdYG4SxFzzY3k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]The songs cover a variety of moods, from quiet contemplative music for space travel to rousing orchestral anthems for the tower defense and ground combat sequences.  I'm no Hans Zimmer, of course, but I hope you find the soundtrack an enjoyable listen!
[/p][p]The demo's development is progressing on schedule, with the focus now on bug fixes and playtesting.  Keep an eye out for its release either at the end of July 2025 or early August 2025.  If you haven't yet, make sure to wishlist the game and get notified as soon as there is a release.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p]

notes.title: Development Update: Let's Explore Your Ship!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="QZfr9gmwgzs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]As I mentioned previously, one of the main principles I wanted to emphasize in this game is [b]your spaceship as a cozy mobile base.[/b]  Not only should you be able to fly your ship and fight with it, but you should also be able to get up out of your chair, walk around, and relax between missions.  To that end, I have added a wide variety of activities for players to enjoy when aboard their vessel.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Play an Arcade Game[/i][/p][p]Test your reaction time and accuracy with this simple arcade shooting game.  Every few seconds, a target will appear and you have a half-second to shoot it before it vanishes.  Scientifically proven in Unified Earth Forces studies to increase morale by 15% and combat effectiveness by 0.3% after sustained play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/6a513a8481bdc5833bcfd6b9332f8bfa33f117b7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Play Soccer (Football)[/i][/p][p]Prove to your shipmates that you were popular in school.  Kick the soccer ball into the goal.  Sometimes easier said than done.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/bb826c02f83febe2b9b4469f72ac957ea0a5eb7b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Read the News[/i][/p][p]The newest edition of the Capitol Journal is printed and left on the mess table after each successful mission.  Have a read and see how the public back home is reacting to your actions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/51573164e5886a3f22be48e476dbf82db9711129.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Mine Asteroids[/i][/p][p]Use the shipboard mining laser to destroy asteroids if any come near your ship.  This allows you to gather Metal, which is stored for use on your next planet mission.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/8cf017a8a74a2df9287efd5821c2ed46a9270f70.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Farm Crops[/i][/p][p]Maintain optimal conditions for plant growth on the ship's hydroponic farm.  Set the correct light intensity and acidity for your crops, and don't forget to refill their nutrient solution.  Once harvested, you will gather Wood, which is stored for use on your next planet mission.  You can also compost it to convert Wood to Dirt, which can be another useful material.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/168024d8eacc44983a989a2b0ceed7280200a2a5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you liked this preview of the activities that players can enjoy between missions.  Also, [b]keep an eye out for the game's[/b] [b]demo release[/b], which might occur as soon as late July 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p][p][/p][p]P.S. The music in the embedded video is one of the original songs I've been making for the game.  Enjoy! [/p]

notes.title: Development Update: Shipboard Farming and Mining
notes.content: [p]Hi there!  [/p][p][/p][p]Today, I want to share some of the new features I've been working on as I continue to improve the game before release.  You can tell from the trailer and description of my game that it is primarily a space combat and tower defense game; however, one of the core principles I want to build in is [b]the spaceship as a cozy mobile base[/b].  Basically, I want the player to be able to spend some relaxing time aboard the ship in between high-intensity planet missions and fleet battles.  In accordance with that principle, I just laid the groundwork for your ship's [b]mining laser[/b] and [b]hydroponic farm[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][i]Mining Laser[/i][/p][p]I populated the space environment with asteroids of varying sizes that you can search for.  Once found, you can walk down to the lower deck of your ship and activate the mining laser.  Keep the laser focused on the asteroid for long enough, and it will disintegrate and grant you some materials that can be used on planet (tower defense) missions.  I am hoping this can also be a fun little random event, as occasionally asteroids can just float by while you are doing other things aboard your ship.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/c92d695a32d3fc686751b9c6c46896fd1b5c991b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/84acf14a3e524df288d36a0a8e19cdb99dc4383c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Hydroponic Farm[/i][/p][p]Your ship's lower deck now has a hydroponic farm.  All six trays are linked to one Hydroponic Control Panel, which you can use to adjust the light intensity, acidity, and nutrients provided to your plants.  If all three conditions are optimal, the plants will grow and can be harvested for useful materials.  There is also a composter nearby to convert the gathered materials into other material types.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/14537182372cc1098b96dedc5355fc375f2027d5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671528/ed5352c73416475c1a3d18b49242e361b2964c38.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]After I finish up these two features, I will also start building in leisure activities that you can do aboard your ship.  Things like card games or something.  That's what the empty areas of the ship will be full of.  I have a few ideas of my own, but the creative folks over at the r/spaceships subreddit have provided me some fun thoughts as well.  Many thanks to them.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoyed this little development update, and don't forget to add this game to your wishlist!  Stay tuned and happy gaming![/p][p][/p][p][i]Nightsail Game Studios[/i][/p]
